nodes.title: CLmax 0.9 of the reflexed wing (SUPERSEDED)
nodes.text: The MH 45-type reflexed section with elevons neutral reaches CLmax = 0.9 at Re ~3e5
nodes.basis: config-study card ESTIMATE. SUPERSEDED 2026-11-09 by B2's trimmed CLmax 0.80 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN, S5010, SM 5 %), which CALC-A1-STALL now reads; the node stays only until B1, B3 and C1 re-point their inputs (CHANGE-LOG D-02)

nodes.title: Box wall and lining 25 mm per side
nodes.text: The transport box loses 25 mm per side to plywood/corrugated wall plus foam lining
nodes.basis: 1/4 in ply + ~18 mm foam; D7 re-derives with the real box

nodes.title: Wing area and aspect ratio
nodes.equation: S = b c ; AR = b^2 / S

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction
nodes.equation: A = 2 (span_in + span_out) f c ; frac = A / S

nodes.title: Prop clearances
nodes.equation: gap_vert = 2 z_m - D ; gap_lat = 2 y_m - D ; gap_tip = b/2 - y_m - D/2 ; gap_tube = (x_mount - r_tube) - x_prop ; gap_wing = z_m - D/2 - t_c c / 2 ; min of the five

nodes.title: Stance tip-over angles toward the pod side (narrow axis) and the wing tip
nodes.equation: h = c - x_cg + foot ; narrow = atan((z_pad - z_cg) / h) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h) ; corner bound at x_cg = x_range[0], z_cg = z_range[1]; target at x_target, z_cg = z_target_a3

nodes.title: Box fit
nodes.equation: internal = external - 2 wall ; slack = internal - envelope (sorted largest first)

nodes.title: params cg range sits inside B3's R1 claims and holds the pack-centred CG
nodes.equation: fwd_ok = x_range[0] - x_fwd ; aft_ok = x_aft - x_range[1] ; centred_fwd = cg_centred - x_range[0] ; centred_aft = x_range[1] - cg_centred ; sm_aft = (x_np - x_range[1]) / c

nodes.title: Pack nominal station vs the station A3's roll-up needs (D-47)
nodes.equation: miss = x_nom - x_req ; room_left = fwd_room - |miss| ; aft_room_left = aft_room - |miss|

nodes.title: Sized mass and A1 reserve from the allocations
nodes.equation: alloc = sum(allocations) ; sized = alloc + growth_allowance + build_overrun ; reserve_cover = growth_reserve - (growth_allowance + build_overrun) ; gate_check = gate - alloc - growth_reserve

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the gate and sized mass
nodes.equation: T/W = n T_max / m ; sag case x voltage_sag ; DL = m g / (n pi D^2/4)

nodes.title: Stall and transition speed at the gate
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CLmax_trimmed)) ; Vt = k Vs

nodes.title: Budget reserve, pessimistic
Wing reference area
nodes.how: Measure the hot-wired core: span x chord.

nodes.title: Aspect ratio
nodes.how: Follows from the measured span and chord.

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction
nodes.how: Measure the cut elevon panels; B3 confirms authority with AVL and the foam-board twin (upper bound 0.25 is checked by B3).

nodes.title: Minimum prop clearance
nodes.how: Fusion interference check (A5) then a ruler on the built aircraft: prop tip to tube face, to the other prop, to the wing tip.

nodes.title: Tip-over angle toward the pod side, worst flying CG corner (forward limit, z +0.03)
nodes.how: Stand the aircraft on a tilting board with the pack at the forward limit (C5 T-C5-TIPOVER / H1 GT-10): record the angle at which it tips toward the pod.
nodes.note: D-30: frame-level corner bound with D5's pad contact z (CL-D5-CONTACT-Z); C5's CL-C5-TIPOVER-WORST (32.4 deg) is the claim of record.

nodes.title: Tip-over angle toward the pod side at the CG target, z_cg 0
nodes.how: As CL-A1-TIPOVER with the pack at the target station; compare with C5's CL-C5-TIPOVER-R1 (32.8 deg, z_cg 0.017).

nodes.title: Aircraft fits the box
nodes.how: Place the props-off aircraft in the built box on its cradles; lid closes without touching fins or tubes (D7).

nodes.title: Sized take-off mass (allocations + planned growth + overrun)
nodes.how: A3 roll-up of every parts.csv against MASS-CG.md (CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED is the maturity-based prediction); weigh the built aircraft with pack (H1).

nodes.title: A1 mass reserve covers the planned growth and overrun
nodes.how: growth_reserve_g in params.json minus (growth allowance + 100 g build overrun; D-48: 145 + 100 = 245 g); A3's maturity growth (CL-A3-GATE-MARGIN) is the stricter check.

nodes.title: Allocations plus reserve equal the gate
nodes.how: 2 600 - sum(allocation_g) - growth_reserve_g must be >= 0; A1 re-runs this script after any allocation change.

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the 2.6 kg gate
nodes.how: Thrust stand, one station, 11x5.5MR on a fresh pack with the 100 A limiter (24.8 A per motor): thrust >= 1.3 kgf gives T/W 2.0 at 2.6 kg (H1, T-E1-STAND).

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the gate, worst pack state
nodes.how: Thrust-stand run on a pack at 3.6 V/cell after a cold soak at 10 degC (H1 GT-02, pass line CL-H1-T-PASS-SAG >= 1.102 kgf), or the fresh value x CL-E2-SAG-F-WORST.
nodes.note: D-49: voltage_sag 0.851 is the one E1/E2 calculation (CALC-E1-WORST on E2's cell data and F1's r_ext 6.5 mOhm, CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR; CL-E1-TW-WORST 2.12); was 0.76 (D-35).

nodes.title: Stall speed at the gate
nodes.how: Trimmed CLmax from B2 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN); flight test: slow-flight stall in FBWA at altitude with airspeed logged (H2, T-B2-STALL).

nodes.title: Transition speed at the gate
nodes.how: Cruise 16 m/s (B1) against 1.3 x the trimmed stall; log airspeed at 'Transition FW done' (F4/H2). Closed by D-01: chord 0.32 and cruise 16 m/s.

nodes.title: Pessimistic reserve at order
nodes.how: I1 re-prices the BOM at order time; reserve = 2 000 - spend, pessimistic column.

nodes.title: params cg.x_range_m forward end is inside B3's R1 forward limit
nodes.how: Re-run after any B3 publish; the built aircraft is balanced at both marks (T-A3-CG-BALANCE, H1 GT-07).
nodes.note: D-24 (closes D-17): params carry B3's range rounded inward; recomputes when B3 re-runs for the 7 deg cant and 0.21 m fins.

nodes.title: params cg.x_range_m aft end is inside B3's R1 aft limit (SM 5 %)
nodes.how: As CL-A1-CG-RANGE-FWD; static margin at the aft mark from the twin's glide tests (T-B3-TWIN-NP).

nodes.title: Pack at B3's nominal station: CG margin to the forward end of the range (B3's roll-up input)
nodes.how: A3 roll-up at the R4 allocations (CL-A3-CG-X-RANGE); balance test with the pack at the nominal station.
nodes.note: D-24 set the pack at x -0.001; D-47 moves the bay 21 mm forward (pod.pack_x_nominal_m -0.022) after the delivered parts lists put the CG at 0.0577 m. B3's CL-B3-CG-CENTRED-AFT is still its R3 value (A3-R3 CG 0.0548): B3 re-runs on A3's next roll-up.

nodes.title: Pack nominal station (D-47) is inside the forward trim room of the station A3 needs
nodes.how: D2 re-lays the bay (forward stop -0.1212), A3 re-runs the roll-up with the pack at the new station, then T-A3-CG-BALANCE with each pack at its marked station.
nodes.note: D-47: pod.pack_x_nominal_m -0.022 against CL-A3-PACK-X-REQ -0.0225 (A3-R5, CG 0.053 target); the 0.5 mm miss is 0.1 mm of CG and sits inside the 3.4 mm forward room. Per weighed pack: 680 g at -0.014, 550 g at -0.022, 503 g at -0.0245.

nodes.title: Weigh the assembled aircraft
nodes.procedure: Pack in, props on, 5 kg scale with 1 g resolution; record with the pack's own mass (H1).

nodes.title: Thrust stand, one station
nodes.procedure: X3108S + 11x5.5MR on the 20 kg load cell (A/B with the 11x4.5MR), fresh pack then a 20 % pack at 10 degC, 0-100 % in 10 % steps, log gf, A, V and rpm (T-E1-STAND, T-B4-STAND).
